home.title:
Make room
for your rhythm.
home.description: A home for your dance journey. Start with a little practice. See where it takes you.

home.practiceDescription: Simple tools that fit your training. Open to everyone, no account needed.
home.connectDescription: A place for the dance community to connect. Coming in a future phase.
home.growDescription: More ways to explore events and battles. Planned for the future.
home.metaDescription: A guest-first home for dance practice, starting with Playground.

playground.title: Your practice. Your playground.
playground.description: Small tools for the work behind the movement. No account required.

playground.metaDescription: Discover public dance practice tools. Start with the Practice Timer preview.

practiceTimer.title: Every round starts here.
practiceTimer.notice: This is a preview of our first practice tool. Timing controls, rounds and presets will arrive in a later phase.
practiceTimer.metaDescription: Preview the future guest-first Practice Timer. The timer is not implemented yet.

identity.loginTitle: A place for your next step.

identity.registerDescription: Registration is coming in a later phase. For now, explore Playground freely. No account is needed.
identity.metaDescription: Account features are planned for a later phase. Playground is open to guests.
